**`(*renderer) addArg`** — `internal/filter/render.go:842` — approx **28 callers**

I enumerated every function/method declared under `internal/` (272 declarations across the tree) and cross-referenced call sites repo-wide. The `renderer.addArg` method (used to register a SQL bind-parameter value and return its placeholder, e.g. `?` or `$N`) is invoked 28 times, all within `internal/filter/render.go` itself, as it's the central helper every predicate-rendering branch (equality, LIKE, regex, JSON containment, IN-lists, etc.) calls to safely parameterize values before building SQL fragments.

For comparison, the next-highest candidates I checked were `jsonArrayExpr` (`internal/filter/render.go`, ~17 callers) and `util.GenUUID` (`internal/util/util.go`) which has 28 textual matches for `util.GenUUID(` but 21 of those are in a single test file (`server/router/api/v1/test/auth_test.go`) rather than organic production call sites — only 7 are outside tests — so it doesn't represent comparable "real" fan-in.

Caveat: this was derived via static text/regex search (no `rg`/Go AST tooling was available in this environment), so counts are approximate and could miscount in edge cases (e.g., shadowed method names), but I manually verified the `addArg` call sites individually and they are all genuine.
